notes: ARMSX2 (PlayStation 2): the upstream Linux arm64 4K-pages AppImage, mounted; its real binary is run, never AppRun.
-batch quits when the game closes, so OpenGamepadUI gets the panel back; -nogui keeps the desktop main window from opening behind the game; -- ends options.
gui_args: Big Picture, the pad-driven UI; no -batch, which would quit at once with no game.
ARMSX2 keeps its settings in ~/.config/ARMSX2/inis/PCSX2.ini (the seed must carry [UI] SettingsVersion = 1).
